description: Check whether a keyboard and mousepad fit side by side on a desk. The keyboard is placed with its B key in front of the screen centre (move it with keyboard_offset_cm). Returns the mouse room left, whether the pad fits or how far it hangs off, how far the mouse sits from the screen centre, and whether a full 360-degree turn at the given sensitivity (cm/360) fits on the pad. Compare several keyboards at once to see which one leaves the most room.

cm_per_360.description: Mouse sensitivity as cm of movement for a full 360 turn

keyboard_offset_cm.description: Move the keyboard from centred; negative moves it left

left_handed.description: Mouse on the left of the keyboard

mousepad.description: small 25x21, medium 36x30, large 45x40, xl 49x42, deskmat 90x40 (under keyboard and mouse), or custom

mousepad_width_cm.description: Mousepad width in cm, when mousepad is "custom"

name: check_desk_fit
title: Check desk and mousepad fit
